headline:
Andalucía cuts its
resale tax from 2027.
sub: Five things Costa del Sol agents should know this week.
items: Transfer tax on resale homes drops from 7% to 6.75% in 2027, then a quarter point a year until it reaches 6%.
The cap for the reduced 3.5% rate rises from €150,000 to €200,000 — €300,000 for large families and buyers with a disability.
Benahavís averaged €5,553/m² in August, still the top end of the national market.
Málaga city signed off ~100 tourist apartments this summer despite the moratorium that began on 25 July.
The market has split: the coast keeps climbing, inland stays cheap — Humilladero at €903/m².
